cd.CD0332: How do I change my profile?
cd.CD0333: In Profile → Settings, tap 'Delete account'. Your data is held for 30 days before permanent deletion, in line with Korean privacy law (PIPA).
cd.CD0334: How do I delete my account?
cd.CD0335: If you created your account with email, go to Profile → Settings to update your password. If you signed in with Google, Apple, or Microsoft, manage your password with that provider — B4K does not store it.
cd.CD0336: How do I change my password?
cd.CD0343: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and we'll get back to you.
cd.CD0346: B4K is a K-culture travel discovery platform for foreign tourists visiting Korea. Explore K-Pop venues, K-Drama filming locations, K-Beauty spots, and K-Culture landmarks on an interactive map, then build your own plan.
cd.CD0348: Create an account with your email and a password, or continue with Google. There is no separate onboarding: after a short consent step, you go straight back to where you were.
cd.CD0349: How do I create an account?
cd.CD0350: B4K is available in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Thai, and Brazilian Portuguese. You can change your language anytime in Profile settings.
cd.CD0353: B4K is a K-culture travel discovery platform for foreign tourists visiting Korea. Find K-Pop venues, K-Drama filming locations, beauty spots, and more — then build your own plan.
cd.CD0355: You can explore the map and build a plan without an account. Saving places and plans and joining the leaderboard require signing in.
cd.CD0356: Do I need an account to use B4K?
cd.CD0357: B4K is available in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Thai, and Portuguese (Brazil).
cd.CD0360: Tap any pin on the map to open the place panel, then tap the bookmark icon to save it. Saved places appear in your Saved tab.
cd.CD0361: How do I save a place?
cd.CD0362: Open a place on the map and tap 'Add to plan' in the panel. You can add multiple stops, reorder them, and let B4K calculate the best route.
cd.CD0363: How do I build a plan?
cd.CD0365: Open a place on the map and add it to your plan. Add stops, reorder them, and each leg shows an estimated travel time. When you are happy with it, tap Save plan. You can also use Ask AI to make a plan for you.
cd.CD0366: How do I create a plan?
cd.CD0367: Yes. You can explore the map and build a plan as a guest — your plan in progress is kept in your browser so it survives a refresh. You only need to sign in when you tap Save plan, and your plan moves to your account automatically.
cd.CD0368: Can I use B4K without an account?
cd.CD0369: A plan can hold up to 48 stops: 6 per day, for up to 8 days. Once a day is full, B4K offers the next day; once the plan is full, the Add button is disabled and a message lets you know.
cd.CD0370: Is there a limit on how many stops a plan can have?
cd.CD0372: Open any place from the map and tap the bookmark icon. Saved places appear in your Saved tab, where you can browse them all in one list.
cd.CD0373: How do I save a place?
cd.CD0374: Lists let you group your saved places, for example one list per city or per interest. Lists hold places only; saved plans aren't sorted into lists.
cd.CD0376: In Saved, choose Plan from Saved, pick the places you want, then tap Make plan. B4K puts them in order by day and opens the new plan so you can fine-tune it.
cd.CD0377: How do I make a plan from saved places?
cd.CD0379: First try refreshing the page. If the map still doesn't appear, check your internet connection and disable any ad or script blockers, which can interfere with the map. If the problem continues, contact us using the email below.
